HERO_SUB: Anne, your heart for older learners shines through everything you do. The kindness, the patience, the clear pricing. What's left is mostly small website tidy-ups that help people trust you at first glance.
BREAKDOWN_INTRO: We looked at four things: how safe your business is, how clearly people can see who you are, how easily they can find you, and what it's like to work with you. Weighted for a solo community educator.
BAND_TEXT: At 57 you're finding your feet, right at the edge of good bones. Nothing needs rebuilding. The biggest lifts are quick website tidy-ups you can do in an afternoon.
CALIBRATION: Why these weights: your clients are mostly people aged 55+ who need to trust you before they reach out, so Data & Defence and Identity & IP count for a little more (30% each) than Visibility and Experience (20% each).
D_NOTE: A few leftover website template bits (a 'Coming Soon' banner, an empty block, a newsletter form that isn't connected) can look like warning signs to the very people you teach. A short 'what my sessions cover' note would also protect you.
I_NOTE: Twenty-plus years in adult education and warm, genuine testimonials. Adding your ABN to the footer and joining the Be Connected network would let anyone double-check you in seconds.
V_NOTE: Your Eventbrite workshops are working well. You're not on Google Maps yet, and 'savvy to scams' is a common phrase, so a free Google Business Profile would help locals find you. It keeps your home address private.
E_NOTE: Your one-issue-per-session approach and the free companion policy are thoughtful. The one gap is that every booking goes through a web form, and a phone number would help anxious callers.
S1_TEXT: Letting clients bring a family member or carer at no cost removes embarrassment and helps adult children support their parents. It's a real point of difference, so keep it front and centre.
S2_TEXT: Keeping each session to one scam concern avoids overload and helps new habits stick. That's good teaching, and your clients notice.
S3_TEXT: $0 intro call, $140 session, $375 three-part series, all listed up front. No sales pressure, which matters a lot to budget-conscious seniors.
WEEK_TEXT: Hide the leftover template blocks, connect the newsletter form, add your ABN to the footer, and put a phone number at the top of the site.
MONTH_TEXT: Add a short 'what my sessions cover' note, set up a free Google Business Profile for Perth (address hidden), and let people book the free call straight from a calendar.
READY_TEXT: Join the federal Be Connected network as a community partner, and turn your workshop plan into a simple one-page guide for councils and community groups.
A1_TEXT: In Squarespace, hide the empty blocks and the 'Coming Soon' banner, and connect the newsletter form to a mailing list. Your site will look as careful as you are.
A2_TITLE: Add your ABN to the footer
A2_TEXT: Type 'Savvy to Scams (ABN 47 152 412 557) · Perth, WA' into your footer settings. You teach people to check ABNs, so this lets them check yours.
A3_TITLE: Put a phone number up top
A3_TEXT: Someone worried about a dodgy text often just wants to talk. A 'Prefer to talk? Call Anne' line in the header opens the door for them.
GENTLE_NOTE: Small tidy-ups for a business whose heart is already in the right place.
